component: Goodix GR551x SDK application-error utility source oracle

upstream.qualification: The selected carrier is the earliest located public commit containing the byte-exact SDK 1.7.0 file. It is not an official Goodix release commit and is not claimed to be Even's checkout.

version_boundary.earlier_official_snapshot: GR551x SDK V1.00: same 43-row shape but different 1024-byte buffer and wording
version_boundary.incompatibility: 2.0.1 expands the table from 43 to 46 rows, adds repeat-CID/cache errors, and moves the formatter buffer to static storage

g2_boundary.classification: copied and adapted third-party utility under a first-party retained path; not evidence that the G2 Apollo firmware links a Goodix BLE stack
